messages:
sam: Heads up — ran the customer evidence validation for the compliance request and found audit coverage gaps across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Need quick triage and backlog picks :eyes:

sam: short list: console export/download events missing for org-admins, billing invoice:view is only logged server-side (no user context), API GW drops upstream auth failure details for some 401 flows, runtime worker job restarts aren't emitting k/v of job_id, and KMS key-rotation events use a nonstandard schema.

tanya: ugh. can you paste examples of the missing events or the schema mismatch? will help decide quick fixes vs larger work.

sam: sure — minimal reproducer below. payload we expect for billing: `billing.invoice.view` should include `{"user_id": "<id>", "invoice_id": "<id>", "amount": <cents>, "request_id": "<uuid>"}`. current event only has `invoice_id` + `amount` (no user_id/request_id).

lee: that explains why customer evidence failed. compliance needs user_id and request_id anchored to KMS audit IDs for encryption ops.

carol: for console export: frontend emits `console.export.started` and `console.export.completed` but we only forward completed w/ success=true/false. missing the `initiator` and `scope` fields. small change in the console proxy should capture initiator info — low-risk.

sam: API GW case — we intentionally strip headers for PII, but we lost `x-auth-method` and `x-upstream-reason` in the drop path. if we keep just `x-auth-method` and `error_code` we should still be within retention/PII policy.

dmitri: runtime worker restarts: current plan logs `worker.restart` with timestamp and host, but not `job_id`. adding `job_id` is straightforward but we need to ensure it doesn't leak customer secrets. `job_id` is safe.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-5123: audit-coverage-gap-api-gw-auth-console-billing-runtime (assignee: unassigned).

tanya: recommended triage: 1) console export (low effort) -> pick up now, 2) billing event (medium) -> patch service to add user_id + request_id, 3) runtime job_id (low) -> patch next release, 4) API GW header preservation (needs privacy review) -> spike, 5) KMS schema standardization (research + migration plan).

sam: proposed owners: console -> @carol, billing -> @lee, runtime -> @dmitri, API GW privacy spike -> @tanya, KMS schema -> security + infra pairing (sam + infra). ETA: quick fixes by end of sprint (2w) where low effort.

carol: picking console now. I'll open PR to the proxy to attach `initiator` and `scope` and add unit tests to validate audit payload shape. PR will reference SEC-5123. :thumbsup:

lee: billing will need a small DB migration to backfill `user_id` for legacy views (if available). I'll scope the PR to add fields and a backfill job. estimate 3 days dev + 1 day backfill run.

dmitri: runtime change queued behind current release; I can merge small logging change and add e2e check in staging.

tanya: for API GW, I'll do a privacy matrix before we preserve any headers. if that looks good, spike should be 1-2 days.

sam: KMS schema — observed `kms.key.rotate` currently uses `key_id` and `actor`, but we want `key_id`, `actor_id`, `rotation_type`, `rotation_request_id`. need compatibility shim. I'll draft migration notes and a small compatibility layer in the key service.

audit-bot: Comment on SEC-5123: added label `audit-evidence-required` and slack-notify on PR merge.

sam: action items recap (short):
- carol: console export audit fields (PR in 48h)
- lee: billing event enrichment + backfill (estimate 4d)
- dmitri: runtime job_id logging (staging check)
- tanya: API GW privacy spike (2d)
- sam: KMS schema migration plan (doc + compatibility shim)
- ops: schedule end-to-end evidence run against sample customer within 1 week after PRs merge

carol: will post a follow-up thread when PR is up. tagging @sam @tanya @lee.

sam: thanks all. if anything blocks, call it out in the ticket.
